_note: Sentinel state. This file is rewritten by the receive-monorepo-release workflow when the monorepo dispatches a new VSIX release; that workflow opens a release PR updating this pointer and a per-version releases/<version>.json marker. On merge, release-on-merge.yml reads the marker, re-verifies the VSIX sha256 and SLSA build provenance against vsixSha256/monorepoRepo, then creates the release that fires the publish workflows. The first real release replaces these null fields.
